data.title: Polkadot at $1.20 or Ethereum at $2,530: Which Is More Likely to Double First?
data.description: Polkadot has surged nearly 20% in a month while Ethereum bleeds through nine straight days of ETF outflows, and the gap between their paths to a price double reveals a surprising divide in which coin holds the real momentum right now.
